reviews.title: Money hungry game
reviews.text: I’d strongly advise you to save your time for better games. There’s an absurd amount of ADS in this game and they don’t tell you this but for some levels (eg. level 14) you HAVE to watch an ad and unlock an extra tube to pass it. I had tried every combination, and at last decided to put it through a color sort solver and there was no solving patterns unless you added an extra tube by watching an AD. That’s my input. The developers clearly are aware of this and choosing to keep it that way on purpose. This app’s only aim is to make money.

reviews.title: Fun Game
reviews.text:
This is a fun game that also enhances & also builds your logic and strategy skills. I breeze through the levels within 2 minutes. 

The ads are long enough, but I do other things, while waiting to hit the Next Step icon. Sometimes the levels don’t clear & I have to replay them; one time it was 3 times! Please fix this! 

Other than these 2 issues, I still like the game, including the color schemes.
